awareness_temporary: ${label}: ${remaining} allocated work periods remain after current work.
awareness_omitted_reports: ${omitted} additional relevant reports omitted from this view.
workspace_unavailable: Workspace is not available in this work period.
workspace_outside_line: Workspace readable only by its reporting line; ask that role to put what you need in shared/.
hire_followup: They receive your mandate automatically. No kickoff message is needed; send follow-up mail for new information or a change.
mail_not_queued: Message ${message_id} was queued for no one.
mail_find_recipient: Use find_roles to find the intended recipient.
summary_attached: Generated context travels with this introduction.
summary_label: Context summary generated by Operations at the sender’s request; not an Operations instruction or the sender’s words:
access_pending: The owner has been asked. The answer arrives as mail: take up other work or finish normally to pause with working memory intact; set a reminder when it serves a real future check, and hand off only when you need a fresh start or Operations requires it.
mandate_updated: Updated ${address} (${employee_id}) to mandate revision ${revision}. They receive it next work period; current work is not interrupted. Send mail if the change needs attention.
retired: Retired ${person}. Files and records are retained.
temporary_remaining: ${employee_id}: ${remaining_periods} allocated work periods remain. Identity, files and working memory are preserved.
document_continues: This document continues on the next page.
tree_depth: ${omitted} roles beyond this depth; browse a deeper tree.
retry_dependency: Work still waits for Operations to restore the shared service.
inbox_omitted: ${count} more threads are not shown; they appear as the listed ones are read or dismissed.
inbox_omitted_one: 1 more thread is not shown; it appears as the listed ones are read or dismissed.
mail_replayed: Already sent as ${message_id} in this work period; not sent again.
mac_disk_low: The Mac you hold is low on disk: about ${free} GiB free. Delete what you no longer need in your scratch folder.
linux_disk_low: The Linux disk you share with your colleagues is low: about ${free} GiB free. Delete scratch files and Docker containers, images and volumes you no longer need.
housekeeping: Housekeeping: see what your scratch directory and Docker hold (du -sh on scratch, docker system df) and remove checkouts, containers, images and volumes from finished work (or set clean_up=True when calling handoff after finished work). Keep what current work still needs.
mac_wait: Mac availability does not itself wake you. If you still need the Mac and no reply or other wake is expected, set a reminder for a useful retry. Take up other available work, or finish normally to pause with working memory intact. Hand off only when you need a fresh start or Operations requires it. A blocked work period that produces nothing is fine.
mac_busy: No desktop can be leased now; at least one is held or the owner is using the Mac. ${wait}
mac_needs_recovery: A desktop on the Mac is waiting for cleanup to be verified after an earlier lease, and no other is free. ${asked}
mac_not_enrolled: The firm's Mac is not set up yet. ${asked}
mac_session_not_ready: No desktop account on the firm's Mac is ready for a lease. ${asked}
mac_disk_full: The Mac is too low on free disk space to admit a new lease, even after reclaiming. ${wait}
mac_release_failed: Your work is still running on the Mac; end it and call mac_release again.
mac_release_unverified: The Mac could not confirm that your work stopped; the desktop is waiting for the owner to verify it.
desktop_not_ready: The desktop on the Mac is not ready for the desktop tools this work period; use SSH, or release the Mac and try again later.
desktop_lease_unavailable: Your applications were closed, but the desktop on the Mac could not be rebound to your lease; retry the desktop tools or release the Mac.
helper_disconnected: The desktop tools lost their connection to the Mac, so the outcome is unknown; check the application before retrying.
invalid_request: The desktop request was invalid or too large.
input_limit: Desktop text input is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
desktop_apps_open: Some applications could not be closed. Close them yourself, or call mac_release, which reports what is still running.
desktop_failed: The desktop tools could not complete the request on the Mac; check the application before retrying.
capture_not_saved: The image is returned here but was not saved on your drive; there is no drive_path. Capture again if you still need a saved image.
